A commitment has one accountable lead plus zero or more contributors. Only the lead consumes the non-transferable register slot; approved Work and exact-CID-de-duplicated evidence preserve contributor attribution only while Accepted and unfrozen, but evidence contributes at most one recognition participation credit per contributor while later CIDs remain provenance.
